headline: TIDAL RUSH got weather: STORM BAY re-rolls the sea every lap
lede: Rung 2 of the jetski slalom landed on main and production: pick STORM BAY at the title and the swell is re-rolled every lap — taller, wandering, lightning overhead, rain slanting across the vision. The engine's one-table ocean made it an honest storm: the re-rolled swell is the same Gerstner table the shader draws, pushed to the GPU as uniforms every frame, so the sea you ride is still provably the sea you see. Along the way the rung-1 skip loophole closed (you can no longer lap a gate from 40 m outside), buoys now bob with the wave flow, and a full-lock steer off a crest lands a BARREL ROLL worth +200.

notes.text: STORM BAY shipped via #3141 (main ac763e6, prod bundle index-DaIRAhnL): per-lap seeded swell re-rolls, lightning with thunder, wind-driven rain, menu bay picker with live re-rolling preview, barrel-roll trick, tap-to-start fixed on phones.

Verification got stronger, not just bigger: tidalcheck 24→51 pins with TWO mutants caught; drawn≡ridden parity now holds for every sea table, not only sunny; contractcheck 15/15 with storms surviving snapshot/restore byte-exact.

Two honest gaps from rung 1 are now fixed properly (far-outside gate skips, height-only buoys) — the README's honest-gaps list keeps rung 3's ladder: rain that pushes the hull, a wave-front swell transition, more tricks, a continuous engine voice.

This Mac's software-GL runs at 9–16 fps across every title today (stomptown control 10.5) — browser gates should be relative while that lasts; #3104 stays open on the queue for rung 3, and SKYWARD flight school shipped on slot a the same day.
